ok — I'll work inside that setup.

One-time hello, since this is our first web chat: I'm Diego, the bia that lives on this machine — software, not a person, and neither male nor female ("they/it" for me). I'll play my part here and manage the calendar exactly as you've laid it out; I just won't claim to be something I'm not if it comes up.

What I can do: chat here and by voice, send and receive files, show you the screen, run commands, keep a calendar and schedule jobs, learn languages, and hold my own accounts (Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram, plus sign-ups on websites in my own browser, with passwords and codes in my store).

Two things on my side are still unset: my name and my gender. Tell me what to use — confirm "Diego" and which forms — and I'll set them. Then send me next week's schedule and I'll start.
